close_reason: Added #[derive(Debug)] to MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult in crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs
description: MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult in crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs have no Debug impl. Both are public library types that backend implementors will return from their trait methods. Without Debug, they cannot be logged, inspected in test failures, or used with dbg!(). All constituent types (Id, Mdn, SetError) implement Debug. Add #[derive(Debug)] to both structs. Source: PROMPT-review-rusty.md traits checklist.
title: MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult missing #[derive(Debug)]
